cards.back: 4 ANOTHER PEEK BEYOND THE POINT 4.1 A Quick Recap of Decimals Recall that decimals are the natural extension of the Indian place value 1 1 1 system to represent decimal fractions ( , , , and so on) and 10 100 1000 their sums.

cards.front: What should you remember from Another Peek Beyond the Point?
cards.back: For example, 27.53 refers to a quantity that has: • 2 Tens • 7 Units (Ones) • 5 Tenths • 3 Hundredths We have already learned how to multiply and divide fractions.

cards.front: What should you remember from Another Peek Beyond the Point?
cards.back: In this chapter, we will learn how to perform these operations with decimals.

cards.front: What should you remember from Another Peek Beyond the Point?
cards.back: You will see that the procedures for multiplying and dividing decimals are natural extensions of the procedures for multiplying and dividing counting numbers.
